other.content: This is a demo medical-education app for patients with serious diagnoses. Tone, safety, and grounding matter more than cleverness. It is NOT HIPAA compliant by design — all sample documents are fictional and the UI must keep it that way.

rules.rule: Never remove or weaken the demo disclaimer, the not-medical-advice wording, or the instruction not to enter real health information.

Prompts and system instructions must keep these safety rules: no survival statistics or life-expectancy figures, no definitive medical claims, second-person voice ('you/your'), every answer grounded in retrieved sources.

All LLM calls must go through providers/ interfaces (LLMProvider.complete_tool for structured output) so the mock provider keeps working in tests. Never call anthropic/openai SDKs directly from agents or routes.
Structured output must use forced tool calls (complete_tool) — never parse JSON out of free-text model responses with regex.
Do not commit secrets, .env files, real patient data, or built knowledge stores (knowledge/*/store/). Corpus raw text under knowledge/*/raw/ is committed.
SSE event shapes emitted by backend/src/patient_companion/agents/pipeline.py must stay in sync with the ServerEvent union in frontend/lib/types.ts.
